name: Prize custodian
design: Medium strong female with pale grey leopard-spotted hide, broad alien exposed mandibles, smooth domed cranium, long black dreadlocks bound in two rear loops. Formal ochre tunic with dark shoulder shawl crossed over chest, narrow bronze trim and long split hem, wrapped shins. Carries a small CLOSED rectangular prize case with handle in left hand, right hand rests on a sash holding one round medallion. No trophy skulls.
